This space is an unofficial client for Stremio add-ons. Add-ons are small web services made by independent developers. Telos only shows what an add-on offers and plays it: it includes no add-ons, hosts no videos and does not check what an add-on provides. You are responsible for what you add and watch, and for having the right to watch it where you live. Some add-ons use BitTorrent, which shows your IP address to other users. Torrents (Telos Downloads and Telos Video) connect only through the selected WireGuard proxy of Telos Network. Telos opens a local HTTP proxy for it, which exists only while Telos Network is on and the proxy is connected. Otherwise torrents wait and nothing connects directly.
